svg.title: Package Managers Animated SVG
svg.desc: Animated educational SVG explaining npm, Yarn, and pnpm package manager flow.

g.text: How packages are resolved, installed, stored, and used in your project
ⓘ Package manager = installs dependencies, manages versions, lock files, scripts, and workspaces
Exact resolved versions for reproducible installs
command → package.json → semver → lock file → cache → registry →
dependency graph → peer deps → install layout → scripts → audit → import
npm / Yarn install packages per project.
pnpm stores once and links them.
